messages:
Iris M.: FYI the new fncall validator (strict mode) is flagging tool outputs as invalid and routing them away. seeing ~2.9% reject_rate on beta slice.
Jamal B.: do we have concrete examples? schema mismatch or type errors?
Iris M.: mostly type-mismatch + missing nested object. example in logs: `tool_response: \"{\\\"result\\\": \"[]\"}\"` -> expected object.
Priya S.: product concern: current behavior re-runs on fallback and that double-charges tokens. we should not bill for the retry if its an internal correction.
Jamal B.: billing cannot just ignore runs. proposal: emit `X-Validation-Outcome: soft-warning` header and a short contract so billing can zero-out retries when header present.
Iris M.: also we need better telemetry: add metric `validation.v1.reject_rate` and a dimension `reason=[type_mismatch, missing_field, malformed_json]`. send traces with `validation.strict=true`.
Priya S.: console UX: show "Schema warning" badge on invocations and a link to raw payload when sampled. add admin toggle "treat validation as warning" for enterprise.
Jamal B.: rollout plan: 1) metric only, 2) surface badge, 3) soft-warning on 1% traffic, 4) expand to 10% after 48h, 5) enable billing contract after sync.
Iris M.: sampling: canary=100% raw capture, prod=1% per-reason with pii scrub + hashed user id.
deploy-bot: Canary validator v1.3 started on eng-platform (slice: beta). :rocket:
Iris M.: if reject_rate > 3% auto-pause. creating PR to add header + enum reasons.
Priya S.: please loop in billing and support for dashboard labels and quota rules.
Jamal B.: opening RFC for the header and sampling schema.
